name: St. Johann im Walde
kurzbeschreibung: Tiny scattered village in the Drautal valley, surrounded by untouched mountain wilderness and traditional Osttirol way of life.
beschreibung:
St. Johann im Walde lies on a sun-exposed terrace high above the Osttiroler Drautal at 1,068 meters above sea level, within the district of Lienz. The village with around 300 inhabitants is one of the smallest municipalities in Osttirol and has preserved its village character – numerous farms are spread as a classic scattered village across the wide meadows and slopes around the Parish Church of St. John the Baptist.

The location at the foot of the Hochgrabe and with views of the Lienzer Dolomiten makes St. Johann im Walde a starting point for quiet hikes away from the main routes. The Panoramaweg toward Leisach or tours to the Bocksteinkapelle, a small pilgrimage site on a hill above the Drautal, show the untouched side of Osttirol. In winter, groomed cross-country ski trails lead across the open high plateau, and the nearby Schobergruppe remains an insider tip for ski tourers looking for quiet slopes.

The Osttiroler way of life is evident here in the many actively managed farms that sell regional products such as Osttiroler Schafskäse, Speck and Brot directly. Anyone not looking for a place to stop with a giant menu, but rather a cup of coffee with a farmer on the terrace, is in the right place here. St. Johann im Walde is not a place for big-city expectations – those who accept that get honest Osttiroler hospitality and scenery that does not yet feel staged. 🏘️
